name: muga
description: Privacy without breaking creator links. Strips 450+ tracking params, preserves creator affiliate referrals. Open source.

scripts.dev:chrome: npm run build:content && web-ext run --source-dir src/ --target chromium
scripts.dev:firefox: npm run build:content && bash scripts/with-firefox-manifest.sh web-ext run --source-dir src/ --target firefox-desktop
scripts.build:chrome: npm run build:content && web-ext build --source-dir src/ --artifacts-dir dist/chrome/ --overwrite-dest
scripts.build:firefox: npm run build:content && bash scripts/with-firefox-manifest.sh web-ext build --source-dir src/ --artifacts-dir dist/firefox/ --overwrite-dest
scripts.build: npm run build:chrome && npm run build:firefox
scripts.lint: bash scripts/with-firefox-manifest.sh npx --no-install web-ext lint --source-dir src/
